listen_host.description: IP address or hostname for the primary listen socket (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: Port number for the primary listen socket.

max_job_size.description: Maximum allowed job payload size in bytes. Larger jobs are rejected.

user.description: System user account to drop privileges to after binding to the port.

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent client connections (0 means unlimited).

timeout.description: Default timeout (seconds) for job operations such as reserve and bury.

pidfile.description: Path to PID file. Set to empty string ('') to disable PID file creation.

log_file.description: Log destination: '-' for stdout/stderr, or a file path (e.g., '/var/log/beanstalkd.log').

data_dir.description: Directory to persist jobs to disk (enables durability). Empty string disables persistence.

use_binary_protocol.description: Enable the older binary protocol (use false unless required for compatibility).

slab_increment.description: Percentage to grow slab size when a larger slab is needed. Larger values reduce overhead but waste more memory.

watch_listens.description: List of additional listen addresses (e.g., for multiple network interfaces or IPv6/IPv4).
